FEEDBACK_DESCRIPTION: Review feedback, replies, and what to do next.
FEEDBACK_QUEUE_DESCRIPTION: Feedback appears here when it needs someone to respond.
CAMPAIGNS_DESCRIPTION: Review messages your team created and whether they have been sent.
TEMPLATES_DESCRIPTION: Review localized templates, their versions, and whether they are ready to use.
EMAIL_DESCRIPTION: Check whether your email service is ready and which sending channel is active.
NAME: Name
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no records available in this view.
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Messages couldn't be loaded. No sample data is shown in their place.
CAMPAIGN_LANGUAGE_DESCRIPTION: Every recipient currently receives this language. Email campaigns must use a template published for the same language.
CAMPAIGN_OTHER_LANGUAGES_DESCRIPTION: This editor changes the sending language only. Other saved language versions stay unchanged.
CAMPAIGN_ADVANCED_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION: This campaign also uses {{types}}. Their existing content stays unchanged.
CAMPAIGN_INBOX_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION: Write the notification people will see in their inbox.
CAMPAIGN_EMAIL_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION: Choose an enabled email template version for the sending language.
EMAIL_VARIABLE_VALUES_DESCRIPTION: Enter a JSON object with the values required by this template, for example {"name":"Ada"}.
CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL_REQUIRED: Choose at least one sending channel.
CAMPAIGN_LANGUAGE_DUPLICATE: This language already has saved campaign content.
CAMPAIGN_EMAIL_VARIABLES_INVALID: Template values must be a valid JSON object.
CAMPAIGN_MULTI_LANGUAGE_PRESENTATION_CHA: This campaign has more than one saved language. You cannot add a new sending format until every language has matching content.
CAMPAIGN_MULTI_LANGUAGE_LIMIT_DESCRIPTIO: This campaign has more than one saved language. You can edit its current formats, but adding email or an inbox message would leave other languages incomplete.
CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Review the recipients and final message before sending or scheduling.
CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_LOADING: Loading the audience and message preview
CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_LOAD_FAILED: The audience or message preview could not be loaded. Nothing has been sent.
CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_STALE: This campaign changed after the review loaded. Close this window and review the latest version before sending.
ESTIMATED_RECIPIENTS_DESCRIPTION: The service recalculates the final audience when sending starts.
CAMPAIGN_REVIEW_WARNING_DESCRIPTION: Review the campaign language and content before sending.
SCHEDULE_AT_DESCRIPTION: Leave this empty to send now, or choose a future local date and time.
CREATE_CAMPAIGN_DESCRIPTION: Creates a draft. Check the audience, preview the message, and review it before sending.
DELIVERIES_DESCRIPTION: See the sending result for each recipient. Retry only failed deliveries that offer a retry.
DELIVERY_SCOPE_REQUIRED_TITLE: Open a campaign to see delivery results
DELIVERY_SCOPE_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION: Delivery results belong to one campaign. Open this page from a campaign to see its recipients and sending channels.
INTERNAL_NOTE_PRIVATE: Internal notes are never sent to recipients.
MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Write a clear response or internal note
OPERATION_ACCEPTED: The change was accepted and is being applied. Refreshing the latest results.
OPERATION_FAILED: The change was not accepted. Review the error, correct the issue, then try again.
REPLY_DELIVERY_EVIDENCE: The result remains pending until the recipient's email service reports delivery.
SENDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: Email cannot be sent until a sender identity is configured
SENDER_UNVERIFIED: Email cannot be sent from this identity until it is verified
TEST_RECIPIENT_PROMPT: Enter the test recipient's email address
CREATE_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION: Create a reusable email template. Review the message before you use it.
EDIT_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION: Update this email template. The new version is saved only after the service confirms it.
TEMPLATE_KEY_DESCRIPTION: A unique identifier for this template. It cannot be changed after creation.
VARIABLES_DESCRIPTION: Use the available variables to personalize the message. Check the preview before sending.
SAMPLE_VARIABLES_DESCRIPTION: Optional JSON values used only for this preview.
SAMPLE_VARIABLES_INVALID: Sample values must be valid JSON.
TEST_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION: Send a test of {{name}} ({{locale}}) to confirm its content and delivery.
DELETE_TEMPLATE_CONSEQUENCE: This removes the template from future use. Existing sent messages are not changed.
RESTORE_TEMPLATE_CONSEQUENCE: Any customized content for this language will be replaced. Review the result before using it.
EDIT_MAIL_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION: Update how this platform sends email. Saved credentials are never shown.
SMTP_ROUTE_DESCRIPTION: Saved delivery-server details are not shown. Only fields you enter here are changed; leave a field blank to keep its current value.
CONFIGURE_CREDENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Enter credentials for this email service. Saved secrets are never shown.
ROTATE_CREDENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Replace the saved credentials. The current secret will no longer be used.
CREDENTIAL_SECRET_WRITE_ONLY: Enter a new secret. It is stored securely and never shown again.
TEST_MAIL_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION: Send a test message to confirm the current email service can deliver it.
SWITCH_PROVIDER_CONSEQUENCE: This changes the email service used for future messages. Review its settings and credentials before sending.
DISABLE_MAIL_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION: Stop this platform from sending email through the current service?
DISABLE_MAIL_SERVICE_CONSEQUENCE: Scheduled and new email messages may not be delivered until the service is restored or reconfigured.
RECOVER_MAIL_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION: Ask the service to recover. Review the reported status before relying on delivery.
PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: This provider isn't available right now.
ACTION_UNAVAILABLE: This action isn't available for the current email service.
EDIT_CAMPAIGN_DESCRIPTION: Update this draft campaign. Review its audience and delivery choices before sending.
AUDIENCE_IDS_REQUIRED: Enter at least one audience identifier.
